title: Mcptoon – Token-efficient MCP CLI client for AI agents
summary: Mcptoon is a lightweight, cross-platform CLI tool designed to reduce token overhead in MCP (Model Context Protocol) interactions for AI agents. It replaces verbose JSON with TOON (Token-Optimized Object Notation), achieving up to 97% token savings for tool discovery and 40-60% for structured data responses. The tool has zero dependencies, supports all major AI agents (Claude, Codex, Cursor, etc.), and includes safety features like dangerous-operation blocking and local usage tracking.
key_points: Reduces MCP token overhead by 97% for tool discovery and 40-60% for structured data responses using TOON (Token-Optimized Object Notation).
Zero dependencies, pure Python implementation (~50KB install size), cross-platform (Windows, macOS, Linux).
Supports all AI agents capable of running shell commands (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.).
Output formats include TOON (compact), JSON, and space-separated tool names for maximum flexibility.
Safety features: Blocks dangerous operations (e.g., `delete`, `drop`) unless explicitly confirmed with `--destructive`.
Local usage tracking (never transmitted) and schema caching (5-minute TTL) for efficiency.
Configurable via `~/.mcptoon/config.json` or project-level `.mcptoon.json`; supports both stdio and HTTP MCP servers.
Includes a Python API for programmatic use and custom tool handlers to bypass MCP entirely.
No telemetry, analytics, or credential storage; prioritizes privacy and security.
Apache 2.0 licensed with comprehensive testing (98 tests) and contribution guidelines.
